newsitem.title: USA: Biogen gets European nod for AVONEX.
newsitem.headline: Biogen gets European nod for AVONEX.

text.p: Biogen Inc said on Monday that the European Commission has approved AVONEX (Interferon beta-1a) as a treatment for relapsing multiple sclerosis in the 15 member countries of the European Union.

Biogen said that AVONEX will be available by prescription in the United Kingdom beginning this week, and in Germany and several other European markets within a month. Biogen received a license from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration to market AVONEX in the United States in May 1996.
It is also available in Israel and Cyprus and has been approved for market in Switzerland.

The company said that it will commercialize AVONEX directly in Austria, the Benelux countries, France, Germany, Ireland, Switzerland and the United Kingdom, and will sell through distributors in other European markets.
AVONEX is administered once a week by intramuscular injection at a dose of 30 micrograms, according to Biogen.
